final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS a FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.country, g.a, g.a - o.oa AS ex FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.a > o.oa), l AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS la FROM k), rt AS (SELECT k.a, k.ex, k.a - l.la AS dl FROM k JOIN l ON l.la IS NOT NULL WHERE k.a > l.la) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_wins, AVG(ex) AS avg_excess_overall, AVG(dl) AS avg_excess_latter FROM rt
